ITEM 1 | Roughly 25-28 small tan-to-brown oval pieces, smooth with faint longitudinal ridges and slightly pointed ends, each about 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, dry and matte with no sheen, scattered loosely in two diagonal rows across the left half of the red plate and not touching the apple | 32
ITEM 2 | One whole rounded piece about 7.5 cm across, glossy red blushed over yellow-green, with a visible dark stem cavity on top and a smooth, unbroken skin, resting at the upper right of the plate with some florets tucked beneath it | 160
ITEM 3 | About 10-12 irregular bite-sized clusters, each roughly 2-4 cm across, with cream-white, slightly ivory coloring, a bumpy granular surface, matte and dry, with pale cut stem ends and no browning or char, scattered along the lower right of the plate beside and below the apple | 120
